c: C is a degree on the centigrade scale of temperature.

C can also mean the speed at which light travels in a vacuum.

c-clamp: C-clamp is a clamp in the shape of the letter C.
c-horizon: C-horizon is beneath the B-horizon and above the bedrock.
C-horizon means the same as C horizon.
c-note: A c-note is a United States bill worth 100 dollars.

c-ration: C-ration is a canned field ration issued by the United States Army.
c-reactive protein: C-reactive protein is a byproduct of inflammation.

c-section: C-section is the delivery of a fetus by surgical incision through the abdominal wall and uterus.
C-section means the same as cesarean delivery or caesarean delivery or caesarian delivery.
c. d. gibson: C. D. Gibson is United States illustrator remembered for his creation of the `Gibson girl'.

c. diphtheriae: C. diphtheriae is a species of bacterium that causes diphtheria.

c. h. best: C. H. Best is Canadian physiologist who assisted F. G. Banting in research leading to the discovery of insulin.

c. northcote parkinson: C. Northcote Parkinson is British historian noted for ridicule of bureaucracies.

c. p. snow: C. P. Snow is English writer of novels about moral dilemmas in academe.

c. psittaci: C. psittaci is bacteria responsible for the sexually transmitted disease chlamydia.

c. s. forester: C. S. Forester is English writer of adventure novels featuring Captain Horatio Hornblower.
C. S. Forester means the same as Forester or Cecil Scott Forester.
c. s. lewis: C. S. Lewis is English critic and novelist.
C. S. Lewis means the same as Lewis or Clive Staples Lewis.
c. trachomatis: C. trachomatis is bacteria responsible for the sexually transmitted diseases chlamydia and lymphogranuloma venereum.
C. trachomatis means the same as Chlamydia trachomatis.
c. vann woodward: C. Vann Woodward is United States historian.

c. w. post: C. W. Post is United States manufacturer of breakfast cereals and Postum.

C.P.U. is the part of a computer that does most of the data processing.

c2h6: C2H6 is a colorless odorless alkane gas used as fuel.

c and w: C and W is a simple style of folk music heard mostly in the southern United States.

c battery: C battery is battery used to maintain the grid potential in a vacuum tube.
c clef: C clef is a movable clef that puts middle C on one of the lines of a staff.
c compiler: C compiler is a compiler for programs written in C.
c horizon: C horizon is beneath the B-horizon and above the bedrock.

c major: C major is the major scale having no sharps or flats.

c major scale: C major scale is the major scale having no sharps or flats.

c program: C program is a program written in C.
